items.title: Marian McPartland — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: So we recorded Jimmie Rowles at Eddie Furst’s house

ctx.x: How did you come about choosing the others that you did?

Because they were friends of mine. I know why I recorded Jimmie Rowles. Dave . . . In the case of Dave, I’ve always loved Dave McKenna. It was at a time when nothing much was happening for him. I thought it would be nice to record this guy. Actually, that’s quite a story, how I . . . Charlie Bourgeois [spelling?] and I went around with Dave the evening before the date, trying to keep him from drinking. That’s a whole other story. The one that got hungover was me, doing that. But with the case of Jimmie Rowles . .…
